Hello Caddy!

For more information, refer to the Caddy documentation

EOF msg_ok "Installed Caddy" msg_info "Enabling Caddy Service" $STD rc-update add caddy default msg_ok "Enabled Caddy Service" msg_info "Starting Caddy" $STD service caddy start msg_ok "Started Caddy" local prompt="" read -r -p "${TAB3}Would you like to install xCaddy Addon? " prompt || true if [[ "${prompt,,}" =~ ^(y|yes)$ ]]; then touch /root/.xcaddy-requested # Cold amd64 builds: 488 MiB non-file memory, 2811 MiB additional disk. # Add 512 MiB margin, then round up to 256/512 MiB boundaries. local memory_mib memory_max=max disk_mib memory_mib=$(awk '/^MemAvailable:/ {print int($2 / 1024); exit}' "/proc/meminfo") || memory_mib=0 [[ "$memory_mib" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || memory_mib=0 if [[ -r /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max ]]; then read -r memory_max < /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max || true if [[ "$memory_max" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && ((memory_max / 1048576 < memory_mib)); then memory_mib=$((memory_max / 1048576)) fi fi disk_mib=$(df -Pk /opt | awk 'NR == 2 {print int($4 / 1024)}') || disk_mib=0 [[ "$disk_mib" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || disk_mib=0 if ((memory_mib < 1024 || disk_mib < 3584)); then msg_warn "xCaddy requires 1024 MiB available RAM and 3584 MiB free on /opt (available: ${memory_mib} MiB RAM, ${disk_mib} MiB disk). Optional build skipped; plain Caddy and existing built binaries are unchanged." msg_warn "Increase this CT in Proxmox Resources > Memory / Root Disk, then rerun update inside this CT." return 0 fi local build_dir RELEASE arch build_dir=$(mktemp -d /opt/.xcaddy-build.XXXXXX) mkdir -p "$build_dir/tmp" "$build_dir/cache" "$build_dir/mod" "$build_dir/go" TMPDIR="$build_dir/tmp" GO_VERSION="$(curl -fsSL https://go.dev/VERSION?m=text | head -1 | cut -c3-)" setup_go msg_info "Setup xCaddy" RELEASE=$(curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/repos/caddyserver/xcaddy/releases/latest | grep "tag_name" | awk '{print substr($2, 2, length($2)-3) }') arch=$(get_system_arch uname) curl -fsSL "https://github.com/caddyserver/xcaddy/releases/download/${RELEASE}/xcaddy_${RELEASE:1}_linux_${arch}.tar.gz" -o "$build_dir/xcaddy.tar.gz" $STD tar xzf "$build_dir/xcaddy.tar.gz" -C /usr/local/bin xcaddy rm -f "$build_dir/xcaddy.tar.gz" if $STD env TMPDIR="$build_dir/tmp" GOTMPDIR="$build_dir/tmp" GOCACHE="$build_dir/cache" GOMODCACHE="$build_dir/mod" GOPATH="$build_dir/go" xcaddy build --output "$build_dir/caddy"; then if [[ -d /opt/caddy ]]; then msg_error "Cannot publish xCaddy build: /opt/caddy is a directory" rm -rf -- "$build_dir" return 1 fi mv -f "$build_dir/caddy" /opt/caddy else local status=$? rm -rf -- "$build_dir" return "$status" fi rm -rf -- "$build_dir" rm -f /root/.xcaddy-requested msg_ok "Setup xCaddy" fi } function post_install_script() { msg_ok "Completed Successfully!\n" echo -e "${CREATING}${GN}${APP} setup has been successfully initialized!${CL}" echo -e "${INFO}${YW} Access it using the following URL:${CL}" echo -e "${TAB}${GATEWAY}${BGN}http://${IP}:80${CL}" } function update_script() { header_info if [[ ! -d /etc/caddy ]]; then msg_error "No ${APP} Installation Found!" exit 1 fi if command -v xcaddy > /dev/null 2>&1 || [[ -f /root/.xcaddy-requested ]]; then # Same measured optional-build admission as install; no package, tool or # service effects precede refusal, and pending keeps the opt-in retryable. local memory_mib memory_max=max disk_mib memory_mib=$(awk '/^MemAvailable:/ {print int($2 / 1024); exit}' "/proc/meminfo") || memory_mib=0 [[ "$memory_mib" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || memory_mib=0 if [[ -r /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max ]]; then read -r memory_max < /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max || true if [[ "$memory_max" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && ((memory_max / 1048576 < memory_mib)); then memory_mib=$((memory_max / 1048576)) fi fi disk_mib=$(df -Pk /opt | awk 'NR == 2 {print int($4 / 1024)}') || disk_mib=0 [[ "$disk_mib" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || disk_mib=0 if ((memory_mib < 1024 || disk_mib < 3584)); then msg_warn "xCaddy requires 1024 MiB available RAM and 3584 MiB free on /opt (available: ${memory_mib} MiB RAM, ${disk_mib} MiB disk). Optional build skipped; plain Caddy and existing built binaries are unchanged." msg_warn "Increase this CT in Proxmox Resources > Memory / Root Disk, then rerun update inside this CT." return 1 fi local build_dir RELEASE arch build_dir=$(mktemp -d /opt/.xcaddy-build.XXXXXX) mkdir -p "$build_dir/tmp" "$build_dir/cache" "$build_dir/mod" "$build_dir/go" TMPDIR="$build_dir/tmp" GO_VERSION="$(curl -fsSL https://go.dev/VERSION?m=text | head -1 | cut -c3-)" setup_go msg_info "Updating xCaddy" RELEASE=$(curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/repos/caddyserver/xcaddy/releases/latest | grep "tag_name" | awk '{print substr($2, 2, length($2)-3) }') arch=$(get_system_arch uname) curl -fsSL "https://github.com/caddyserver/xcaddy/releases/download/${RELEASE}/xcaddy_${RELEASE:1}_linux_${arch}.tar.gz" -o "$build_dir/xcaddy.tar.gz" $STD tar xzf "$build_dir/xcaddy.tar.gz" -C /usr/local/bin xcaddy rm -f "$build_dir/xcaddy.tar.gz" if $STD env TMPDIR="$build_dir/tmp" GOTMPDIR="$build_dir/tmp" GOCACHE="$build_dir/cache" GOMODCACHE="$build_dir/mod" GOPATH="$build_dir/go" xcaddy build --output "$build_dir/caddy"; then if [[ -d /opt/caddy ]]; then msg_error "Cannot publish xCaddy build: /opt/caddy is a directory" rm -rf -- "$build_dir" return 1 fi mv -f "$build_dir/caddy" /opt/caddy else local status=$? rm -rf -- "$build_dir" return "$status" fi rm -rf -- "$build_dir" rm -f /root/.xcaddy-requested msg_ok "Updated xCaddy" fi msg_info "Updating $APP LXC" $STD apk -U upgrade msg_ok "Updated $APP LXC" msg_info "Restarting Caddy" rc-service caddy restart msg_ok "Restarted Caddy" msg_ok "Updated successfully!" exit 0 } # framework bootstrap # shellcheck disable=SC1090 # Dynamic URL resolved at runtime - shellcheck cannot follow source <(curl -fsSL "$REPO_BASE/misc/bootstrap/lxc") --script-id "alpine-caddy" -- "$@"
